flared rim at top
tapered neck leading to rounded body
blue floral and landscape patterns covering entire surface
blue decorative band at base
small base with visible edge

detail.issues: Model A has simplified and incomplete floral patterns, missing detailed landscape elements, and altered shape proportions. Model B retains basic shape but has incorrect floral arrangements, missing key decorative bands, and color inaccuracies.

Model A has incorrect screen content (striped pattern instead of the reference's colorful landscape) and a slightly different stand shape. Model B has incorrect screen content (swirled pattern instead of the reference's colorful landscape) and a slightly different stand shape.

Model A has incorrect metal frame color (black instead of gray) and a darker, less accurate wood texture. Model B has a taller structure with an extra shelf and a different wood texture, plus the back panel is misaligned and darker.

Model A has incorrect knob position and shape, missing control labels, and simplified side details. Model B has a slightly off knob shape and position, but overall closer to the reference than Model A.

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect shape and pattern distortion; Model B has incorrect shape and additional red thread-like features.

Model A has incorrect color tone (darker brown), missing texture details (small seeds), and geometric distortion (flattened shape). Model B has less accurate texture details (seed distribution) and color tone (too light).

detail.issues: Both models have similar issues: the base is too reflective compared to the reference's matte finish, and the handle shape is slightly off. Model A also shows a more pronounced highlight on the base in one view.

Model A has incorrect strap color (black vs beige), missing texture details on the case, and a simplified dial. Model B has incorrect strap color (beige vs black), missing dial details, and incorrect case geometry.

detail.issues: Model A has incorrect hook shape and color, while Model B has accurate hook shape and color but incorrect handle shape and color.

Model A has simplified geometry with less detailed pot and platform, and a less accurate handle shape. Model B has a metallic reflection on the platform and slightly off-color pot, with minor handle position variations.

Model A has simplified geometry, missing detailed features like the 'RYCAI' text, door handle, and brush details. Model B has incorrect wheel colors (black instead of yellow), simplified wheel rims, and missing the brush on the front attachment.

Model A has muted colors and less vibrant iridescence compared to the reference, while Model B features overly saturated, pixelated, and distorted iridescent patterns that deviate significantly from the reference's smooth, natural play-of-color.
